topic: Someone discovers a hidden room in their new house
text: I found a hidden room in this blasted house. Just when I thought I'd seen it all, a door hides in plain sight, tucked behind a bookshelf, of all places. The walls are thick with dust, the air stale. What secrets does this box of bricks hold? Did the previous owners think they needed a bunker? Or a place to stash things they didn't want anyone to find? The more I uncover, the less I feel like I know about this place. What a fine mess to deal with.
